title: 第26章 登天梯第27章 鸿钧老祖
slug: 混沌神体之鸿蒙至尊未命名95
content_zh:
叶辰和钱多多来到一座极为宏伟壮观的山峰脚下，只看见一座登山梯直上云霄。
“钱姐姐，走吧！我们一起”
“好！”
“咦，怎么有压力！看来想上这天梯也很难，这是一个重力考验。”
此处其实是落霞圣地一个挑战之地，主要是锻炼人的体魄的，万丈高楼平地起，而人的身体才是一切的根源。
由于10万年前一场灾难，所有的传承基本都已丢失。
现在注重体修的宗门和修士很少，只有极少数的体修宗门。
极致的开发身体，才能走向更高的层次。
“钱姐姐，你试着不要用灵力去抵抗，用肉身去体验这重力威压，尽量的去挑战自己极限，到了极限后，就地修炼，适应之后在继续挑战极限，突破自己”
“这里可以很好磨炼自己的肉身，同时可以打磨修为，让你的修为更加的凝练”叶辰关切的看着钱多多
“好的，你不用管我，我试一试，如果上不去的话，我就会在山峰脚下等你”钱多多甜蜜的一笑。
叶辰豪情万丈，也想试一试自己的极限
此处共有级天梯，每一千级代表一个小境界。
翌日，只见一青涩少年，一身白色玄衣，玉冠束发，互相匀称，步履蹒跚正在级台阶上缓慢攀登
然而此时，山脚下此时已经围满了人，四大宗门年轻的弟子，皇城世家，散修，大概有一万多人。
原来那三个人逃走后心有不甘，逢人便说峰顶有宝库。
一日之间，消息传遍了整个落霞圣地，后面还有陆陆续续的人赶来。
“快看，有一个人已经快到阶了”
“是啊，此人听说是落霞郡叶家的”
“我听说此人是昨日就已经开始登山了”

“是啊！我们也快点登山，不要好处被他一人所得”
“走，快走！”
山脚下的修士议论纷纷！
不过此时叶辰也听不到这些，即便听到了，叶辰也会一笑而过，龙不与虫语。就是这个道理。
每一个人都拿出了自己的全部实力，拼命攀登，一个时辰后，好多人都超越了钱多多，钱多多也不着急，慢慢体验这重力威压，慢慢修炼，打磨修为。
这些人白白浪费了这锻炼了的机会，一味的靠着修为，比拼速度。
这时，一位紫色长衫，金冠束发，玉带环绕，腰间一块精美玉佩悬挂，眼神恶毒的盯着叶辰。
“叶辰，你给我等着，我一定会让你后悔得罪我的！”这人便是皇城，赵家赵千亿，此时赵千亿身边聚集了一批散修。
赵千亿运气不错，得了一位渡劫修士的传承，更是得到了大量的财富！
他便收买了一批散修，此时赵千亿修为也到了筑基境一重天。自信满满的找了叶辰好几天。
没想到在此处碰到了，赵千亿带着20个手下加上他21人，正在迅速的攀登.
叶辰不知道危险已经降临，依旧是一边挑战自己的极限，一边默默的修炼。
就这样一直在努力的攀登着
下面的修士最快的已经到了阶
登上阶的修士慢慢就会被卡住了。
叶辰此时也感觉到了压力，阶才开始对叶辰有点压力，足见叶辰的肉身修炼之强。
一步一步继续着，整个过程，叶辰并没用丝毫灵力抵抗，纯是靠着肉身的力量
叶辰此时的注意力一直在攀登天梯，他并没有注意到，肉身正在一丝丝的凝练，更加的凝实。灵气在重力威压下，更加的凝实。
钱多多此时也到了阶.抬头看一眼叶辰，不自觉的笑容挂满了脸庞，心里一丝甜蜜。
“叶辰，我一定会追随你的脚步！”

钱多多坚定的眼神，无比坚定的信念，支撑着她，一步一步缓慢的前进
钱多多每走一步都用尽了全身的力气，她在挑战自我，突破自我。
content_en:
Ye Chen and Qian Duoduo came to the foot of an extremely majestic mountain peak and saw only a mountain climbing ladder going straight up into the sky.
"Sister Qian, let's go! Let's go together"
"Okay!"
"Hey, why are you so stressed? It seems that it is difficult to climb up this ladder. This is a gravity test."
This is actually a challenging place in the Luoxia Holy Land. It is mainly for training people's bodies. Tall buildings rise from the ground, and the human body is the source of everything.
Due to a disaster 100,000 years ago, all inheritance was basically lost.
Nowadays, there are very few sects and monks that pay attention to physical cultivation, and only a handful of sects that focus on physical cultivation.
Only by developing your body to the extreme can you move to a higher level.
"Sister Qian, try not to use your spiritual power to resist, use your physical body to experience the pressure of gravity, and try your best to challenge your limits. When you reach your limits, practice on the spot. After you adapt, continue to challenge your limits and break through yourself."
"Here you can train your physical body very well, and at the same time, you can polish your cultivation and make your cultivation more condensed." Ye Chen looked at Qian Duoduo with concern.
"Okay, don't worry about me. I'll give it a try. If I can't get up, I'll wait for you at the foot of the mountain." Qian Duoduo smiled sweetly.
Ye Chen is so passionate that he also wants to test his limits
There are a total of 1,000 levels of ladder here, and each thousand levels represent a small realm.
The next day, I saw a young boy, dressed in white and wearing a jade crown, his hair was well-proportioned, and he was slowly climbing up the steps.
However, at this time, the foot of the mountain was already crowded with people. There were about ten thousand young disciples from the four major sects, Imperial City families, and casual cultivators.
It turned out that the three people were unwilling to escape and told everyone they met that there was a treasure house at the top of the mountain.
In one day, the news spread throughout the Luoxia Holy Land, and people came one after another.
"Look, there is a person who is almost reaching the stage."
"Yes, I heard that this person is from the Ye family in Luoxia County."
"I heard that this person started climbing yesterday."
"Yes! Let's climb the mountain quickly and don't want the benefits to be obtained by him alone."
"Go, go quickly!"
The monks at the foot of the mountain were talking a lot!
However, Ye Chen couldn't hear this at this time. Even if he heard it, Ye Chen would laugh it off, saying that dragons don't talk to insects. That's the truth.
Everyone used all their strength and climbed hard. After an hour, many people surpassed Qian Duoduo. Qian Duoduo was not in a hurry, slowly experiencing the pressure of gravity, slowly practicing, and polishing his cultivation.
These people wasted this opportunity to practice, blindly relying on their cultivation and competing for speed.
At this time, a man in a purple gown, with a golden crown tied up his hair, surrounded by a jade belt, and a delicate jade pendant hanging around his waist, stared at Ye Chen with vicious eyes.
"Ye Chen, just wait for me, I will definitely make you regret offending me!" This person is Zhao Qianyi from the Zhao family in the Imperial City. At this time, a group of casual cultivators gathered around Zhao Qianyi.
Zhao Qianyi was very lucky. He got the inheritance from a tribulation monk and got a lot of wealth!
He then bribed a group of casual cultivators, and at this time, Zhao Qianyi's cultivation had reached the first level of the Foundation Establishment Realm. I looked for Ye Chen confidently for several days.
Unexpectedly, we met here. Zhao Qianyi was climbing rapidly with 20 of his subordinates and 21 of him.
Ye Chen didn't know that the danger had come, so he continued to challenge his limits while practicing silently.
Just keep climbing hard
The monks below have reached the fastest level
The monks who ascend the steps will gradually get stuck.
Ye Chen also felt the pressure at this time, and Jie began to put a little pressure on Ye Chen, which showed how strong Ye Chen's physical training was.
Continuing step by step, throughout the whole process, Ye Chen did not use any spiritual power to resist, purely relying on the strength of his physical body.
Ye Chen's attention at this time has been climbing the ladder. He did not notice that his physical body was condensing and becoming more solid. The spiritual energy became more solid under the pressure of gravity.
Qian Duoduo also arrived at this timeJie. raised his head and glanced at Ye Chen. An unconscious smile filled his face, and there was a hint of sweetness in his heart.
"Ye Chen, I will definitely follow in your footsteps!"
Qian Duoduo's firm eyes and extremely firm belief supported her and moved forward slowly step by step.
Qian Duoduo used all her strength in every step she took. She was challenging herself and breaking through.
